english.notes:
(i) Section 5 of the Protection from Harassment Act 1997 was repealed by the Sentencing Act 2020 on the 1st December 2020. Therefore this offence applies to breaches of restraining orders made under section 5 that occurred on or before the 30th November 2020. Breaches of an order under section 5, which occur, on or after 1st December 2020, should be prosecuted under section 360 of the Sentencing Act 2020, see H22092. This was confirmed in the case of R v Jowett (2022).
(ii) Unlike section 2 and section 4, one act is sufficient to breach the restraining order.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
